Original VirelaiOS JPEG vectors, repository LICENSE.

All vectors are baseline sequential (SOF0, 8-bit, Huffman) JPEGs generated
from specified pixel functions, regenerated by running
WEBRENDER_CREATE_JPEG_CORPUS=1 go test ./webrender -run TestJPEGCommittedCorpus.
No downloaded inputs or external decoder implementation.

pattern-{444,422,420,440}.jpg, gradient-411.jpg, odd-420.jpg, restart-420.jpg,
scans-420.jpg, gray-32.jpg:
Generated by jpegEncode in ../../jpeg_test.go — the in-tree baseline encoder
carried for coverage of the subsampling and scan shapes image/jpeg's encoder
never emits (it always writes 4:2:0 or gray). restart-420 carries DRI+RSTm
markers; scans-420 is a legal non-interleaved three-scan sequential file;
odd-420 forces partial edge blocks.

viewer_160x120.jpg:
Generated by the Go standard library image/jpeg encoder (jpeg.Encode,
quality 85) in ../../jpeg_test.go, so the GOVIEW gate fixture is a
real-encoder JPEG, not only the corpus generator's output. Go is
BSD-3-Clause; its image/jpeg package is used here as an encoder and as the
host-only test reference, never as a guest decoder dependency.
